name: Avatar
description:
A user image with a text or icon fallback when it's missing.

  Avatar(size: :lg) do
    AvatarImage(src: user.avatar_url, alt: user.name)
    AvatarFallback { user.initials }
    AvatarBadge(animate: true)
  end

Sized in em: `size:` sets the root's font-size, so the image, fallback text and badge scale together. The `ui--avatar` controller shows the image once it has loaded and keeps the fallback when it's missing or fails.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Avatar(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

AvatarBadge.description: A status dot in the corner. Recolor it with a text-* class; `animate: true` adds a pulsing ping (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion).

AvatarGroup.description: Overlaps a row (or column) of avatars and rings each one with the background color. `size:` / `shape:` are defaults for child avatars that don't set their own.

AvatarImage.description: The photo. Hidden until it has loaded, so a slow or broken image never flashes; the controller then swaps it in for the AvatarFallback.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  Avatar(size:, shape:) do
    AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/01.png", alt: "Sarah Jenkins") if image
    AvatarFallback { "SJ" }
    AvatarBadge() if badge
  end
end

examples.name: Fallback
examples.notes:
When the image is missing, still loading, or fails to load, AvatarFallback renders
instead. Use initials for people, or an icon for a generic placeholder.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
    Avatar(size: :lg) do
      AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/does-not-exist.png", alt: "Sarah Jenkins")
      AvatarFallback { "SJ" }
    end
    Avatar(size: :lg) { AvatarFallback { "MR" } }
    Avatar(size: :lg) do
      AvatarFallback do
        Icon(:user_filled)
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: Seven presets from 2xs to 2xl. The fallback text and badge scale with the image.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-4") do
    UI::Avatar::SIZES.each_key do |size|
      Avatar(size:) do
        AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/05.png", alt: "Daniel Reyes")
        AvatarFallback { "DR" }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Custom size
examples.notes:
Pass a number for an exact pixel size; it drives the root's font-size, so everything
inside still scales proportionally.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
    [ 28, 44, 72 ].each do |size|
      Avatar(size:) do
        AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/04.png", alt: "Ava Thompson")
        AvatarFallback { "AT" }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Shape
examples.notes: `shape: :circle` (the default) or `shape: :rounded`, a squircle-style rounded square.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
    [ :circle, :rounded ].each do |shape|
      Avatar(size: :lg, shape:) do
        AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/03.png", alt: "Mateo Rossi")
        AvatarFallback { "MR" }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Status badge
examples.notes:
AvatarBadge adds a corner status dot. `animate: true` adds a pulsing ping;
recolor it with a text-* class.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex items-center gap-4") do
    Avatar(size: :lg) do
      AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/02.png", alt: "Liam Hudson")
      AvatarFallback { "LH" }
      AvatarBadge()
    end
    Avatar(size: :lg) do
      AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/08.png", alt: "Emma Garcia")
      AvatarFallback { "EG" }
      AvatarBadge(animate: true)
    end
    Avatar(size: :lg) do
      AvatarImage(src: "/avatars/06.png", alt: "Lucas Müller")
      AvatarFallback { "LM" }
      AvatarBadge(class: "text-foreground-subtle")
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Avatar group
examples.notes:
AvatarGroup overlaps a row of avatars and rings each one with the background color.
It forwards a shared size/shape; a +N counter sits in the same rhythm.
examples.code:
phlex do
  AvatarGroup(size: :md, orientation:, aria_label: "Project members") do
    PEOPLE.each do |person|
      Avatar do
        AvatarImage(src: person[:src], alt: person[:alt])
        AvatarFallback { person[:initials] }
      end
    end
    Avatar { AvatarFallback(class: "text-foreground-muted text-sm") { "+5" } }
  end
end

examples.name: Loading animation
examples.code:
phlex do
  Avatar(size: :xl, class: "bg-transparent") do
    AvatarImage(src: "/demo/images/8?delay=2.5&t=#{Time.now.to_f}", alt: "Emma Garcia")
    AvatarFallback do
      span(class: "bg-background-strong size-full animate-pulse rounded-[inherit]")
    end
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes:
The badge moves to the start corner and the group stacks from the right, because
both use logical properties.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(dir: "rtl", class: "flex items-center gap-6") do
    Avatar(size: :lg) do
      AvatarFallback { "NP" }
      AvatarBadge()
    end
    AvatarGroup(size: :md) do
      PEOPLE.first(3).each do |person|
        Avatar do
          AvatarImage(src: person[:src], alt: person[:alt])
          AvatarFallback { person[:initials] }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
